Today's selection covers 106 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 73 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The Pentagon vs. Anthropic + An A.I. Agent Slandered Me + Hot Mess Express
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Medical Device Maker UFP Technologies Hit by Cyberattack

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours
